notes.title: 1.0.13.0 Version Update
notes.content:
Thank you all for waiting. Our big update is here. Now all Towers can use exclusive skills by right-clicking!

In addition, we have also done the following:

1.Fixed a bug in the Shopping Mall Map where the tower position was difficult to adjust
2.Optimize the bullet resources of the Big and Small Evil Eye
3.Fixed a bug that caused the game to stuck when the countdown reaches zero in some cases.
4.Fixed the bug where the medical package texture was generated as a capsule
5.Adjusted the bullet and core texture level, now the bullet will pass above the core when passing through it
6.Optimized the elimination logic of some prefabs, now the game is much more smoother than before
7.Fixed the bug where Tesla’s effects would occasionally report errors
8.Fixed an issue where the hero's energy bar would become very long under certain circumstances.
9.Optimized the size of Magma’s attack effect

notes.title: 1.0.10.0 Version Update
notes.content:
We’ve adjusted the drop logic of Skill Ball. Now the basic drop chance is lower than before, but you can increase the drop chance by increase your Luck!

And we adjust the weight connection of each card and tower in the shop. Now you can get the card or tower you want more easier than before base on the towers and the cards you have. We’ll keep improve the experience of weight connection data in order to make the experience of the game better. 

The HP modify of zombies in different difficulty didn’t work in last update. We’ve also fixed it and adjust the enemies’ data. 

We also make following things:
1.	Lower the zombies’ HP again!
2.	Lightly increase the speed of the zombie
3.	Lightly decrease the HP of the Bunker
4.	Decrease the damage of explosion by Toxic Tag Skill Ball again
5.	Adjust the Text of DESTRUCTION STAFF
6.	Fixed the problem that the damage will go wrong if you have TYRANT MARK

notes.title: 1.0.9.0 Version Updates
notes.content:
Although the Skill Ball System has successfully improve the game experience, but the numerical value was not very well designed. So we’ve adjusted some value of the Skill Ball to ensure that their strength remains the same and the numeric is more in line with the overall numerical structure of the battle.

1.We lower the explode damage of the Skill Ball drop by Toxic Tag tower
2.We lower the target increase number of the Skill Ball drop by Shooter Tag tower


And for the improvement of the battle experience, we’ve also made the following adjust:
1.Lower the price of Red Card and the card which increase data by Towers’ tag
2.When the core isn’t hurt, the tool box will not be directly absorbed like the pills, but you can control the hero to walk through it and pick it up 
3.Increase all data of Tool Box Heal in Core Ability and all Battle cards 
4.Fix the problem of DEMONIZE didn’t work correctly
5.Improve the refresh logic of the shop to ensure the cards number in the shop 
6.Now the Max Hp of Core will increase when the Core is Levelu 
7.Improve the Hp data of the monster to ensure the game experience of low difficulty is better than before 
8.Enhance the effect of DESTRUCTION STAFF 
9.Jennifer now has a new skill


In addition to the above changes, this update also includes the following content
1.Add effects for the Skill Ball of Ice Tag and Focus Tag
2.Fixed the performance will go wrong if Thunder Tag tower is destroyed when the Thunder Tag Skill Ball is triggered
3.Fixed the price will be wrong if you lock the Card or Tower in the Shop
4.Fixed the problem where the knockback effect will knock zombies back to immovable areas.


Thanks for your feedback. In the future, we will ensure that there are at least 1 to 2 updates per week to keep improving our game!

notes.title: 1.0.8.1 Version Update
notes.content:
Some serious problem happened after the update we released yesterday. We’ve fixed most of them in this update

1.Fix the problem that the game will stuck when Big Evil Eye or Small Evil Eye attacks the Core
2.Fix the problem that the Achievement can’t be complete correctly and the reward can’t be unlocked
3.Fixed the problem that if a game ends when the number of Skill Ball reach the max number then there will be no Skill Ball in the next game
4.Fixed the problem that if you pick up the second Skill Ball which drop by Shooter Tag, the buff time won’t be refresh

We’ll keep fixing the serious problem ASAP, thanks for your feedbacks!

notes.title: 1.0.8 Version Update
notes.content:
During the EA online version, we found that the difficulty in the game was too high and the combat experience was too repetitive. In order to solve this serious experience problem, after continuous trying, now we make a new Battle system: The Tower Skill Ball! 

Now in the battle, the Skill Ball might drop when killing a zombie based on the Tags of the Towers you have. You need to control the Hero to pick up the Skill Ball, the skill will be triggered when the Skill Ball is picked up. We now have the following Skill Balls in this version: 

1. Shooter Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. When pick up all Shooter Tag Towers’ have infinite range, increase 	the target num and have 100% deal critical damage, last for 5 second.
2. Charge Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. When pick up, cause an earthquake around the Hero, deal damage to all zombie near hero and stun them for 5 seconds. Earthquake last for 5 seconds. 
3. Unstoppable Tag Tower might drop. When pick up, all Unstoppable Tag Tower will have 50% chance to shoot another bullet to the target if target still alive, the additional bullet can also trigger it. Last for 10 seconds. 
4. Focus Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. When pick up, all Focus Tag Towers’ damage +10%, attack speed +10% and range +10% until the game ends. 
5. Toxic Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. Add 3 levels poison to all zombies. And a explosion of poison will cause when a zombie is dead, deal damage and poison to other zombies. Continue until the end of round. 
6. Ice Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. Freeze all zombies immediately for 5 seconds. 
7. Thunder Tag Tower might drop a Skill Ball. All Thunder Tower will link to hero and cause thunder storm around the hero. Deal damage to all zombies near the hero and make then electrical. Storm last for 8 seconds.

We will keep working on the Skill Ball System. Including but not limited to adjust the skill of the Skill Ball, the mechanism of Skill Ball drop, new Skill Ball for other Tower Tag and other any things which can improve the experience of the game.


In addition to the Skill Ball System, following contents are also include in this version:

1. New Guiding Pictures which include Skill Ball System, Description of Attribute when Core level up and the Shop. 
2. We adjust some Towers’ Tag 
3. We adjust some Towers’ Data to improve the balance of battle
4. Adjust the buff of monsters in Difficulty 1 and Difficulty 2 
5. Fix the problem of sometime the details on the card can’t be showed correctly 
6. Adjust some cards’ description
7. Fix the problem that if the round ends with some zombies with debuff, damage numbers might be showed on the ground where don’t have any zombie in next round 
8. Optimize the animation of Hero attack 
9. Fix the problem that the effect of QUANTUM ARMOR didn’t work correctly 
10. Optimize the attack effect of Brave Statue, its size will be changed base on its range now

notes.title: 1.0.6 Version Update
notes.content:
In this version, we have made several changes:

1. A drag bar has been added to the attribute panel in the battle, which can more intuitively show that the attribute panel can be dragged.
2. The sorting logic of runes has been optimized to ensure that they are sorted from high to low rarity.
3. The attribute modify of all cards will be sorted from buff to debuff value in order to avoid confusion.
4. Optimize the description of some cards to make the effect of the card more clearer
5. Slightly reduce the bullet flying speed of the Viper Temple
6. At the end of the round, the hero will now not disappear before the monster
7. In the store, if there is no enough gold to refresh, the number on the refresh button will turn red.


In addition to the above, we’ve also fixed some following bugs:
1. Fixed the issue where if you choose Jennifer or Green Bo to start a game and click Retry, it will become Rambo.
2. Fixed the issue where the Boss’ attack animation would only be played once
3. Fixed the problem of missing prompt text when zombies are coming, successful survival, etc.
4. Fixed the problem that the Green Bo’s skill name and skill description could not be displayed properly.
5. Fixed the issue where if the pickup range becomes a negative number, the attribute details in the attribute panel will be incorrect.
6. Fixed the issue that hero skill can still be used when the hero is dead.
7. Fixed the problem that the Nano Healer would make display incorrectly in the logbook and in the battle shop.
8. Fixed the issue that our office logo would not move when start the game.  (very important!)

Thank you for your feedback and suggestions. We are currently working on some new battle system. We want to make the experience of game battle more operational and exciting. We hope you will give it a little more time! You are also welcome to leave your suggestion on the Steam~ Thank you!
